about: The greenhouse: its sixteen irrigation booms travel the rig rails over the beds and back, and its three hatches open each in turn.

movers.name: hatch_door_leaf_2
movers.from: A pressure hatch opened by someone passing through, SCORE's own (the game opens a hatch only when the player presses it): swung 100 degrees into the room on the upright line through its hinge hatch_hinge_3, at 30 degrees a second (data/checks/motion.json hatch: a low-energy swing door's 18 to 27, a power door's at most 53), held open 8 s, shut again; each hatch of the room in its own turn of the 60 s round. Its wheel and window ride it.

movers.name: irrigation_boom_1
movers.from: A travelling irrigation boom, SCORE's own (the game stands it still): hung under the rig rails (rig_rail, x -6 to 6), each line of four driven east over its bed at a boom's default 20 feet a minute (0.1 m/s, data/checks/motion.json irrigation_boom: Cherry Creek's 5 to 150) and back, all lines together so none nears another; the three west lines 2.4 m to 9 cm short of the next line's light bar, the east line 1.1 m to the rails' end.
